products.notes: Distributor copy of Alpine spec. RMS @14.4 V 1% THD: CH1-6 35 W @4 / 70 W @2; CH7-8 130 W @4 / 260 W @2 (US retailers also quote 50 W x6 + 150 W x2 @4 ohm at 10% THD). 8 RCA pre outs. Spec lists max input High level 26 Vpp / RCA 11 Vpp and RCA output 4 Vpp (some retailers say 4 Vrms) - unit ambiguity, so voltages not put in fields. 31-band EQ on every channel; delay per channel (range not confirmed). S/N RCA >=95 dB, high-level >=80 dB. System sampling 192 kHz/32 bit; USB-A DAC to 96k/24 + coax in. Tuning: OPTIM iPhone app (auto-EQ, Eilex PRISM) or PC app with KTX-CSP1 mic kit.

Distributor copy of Alpine spec. 8 ch: 100 W @4 / 120 W @2 per ch, 200 W @2 with two channels paralleled (not bridged); total 700 W @4. Inputs: 6 RCA (0.5-4 Vrms, 10 kohm), 6 speaker-level (2-18 Vrms), Toslink (24/96). Up to 8 speaker outs + 1 pre out (copy of ch8). DSP: 30-band PEQ per channel (240 total), gain -30/+10 dB, Q 1-15; delay up to 13.53 ms in 0.01 ms steps; HP/LP/BP 6-30 dB/oct, Butterworth/Bessel/Chebyshev/LR. S/N 110 dB (digital in). Alpine Sound Lab PC software (USB/Wi-Fi) + Alpine Remote Control app.

Distributor copy (predecessor of E802DSP). 8 ch 100 W @4 / 120 W @2; 200 W @2 two ch paralleled; total 700 W @4. 6 high-level + 6 RCA + Toslink in; up to 8 speaker outs + pre out (copy of ch8). EQ: page says 30-band graphic per channel and also '240-band parametric' (type unclear). Delay up to 14.57 ms (0.01 ms steps). X-over HP/LP/BP 6-30 dB/oct Butterworth/Bessel/Chebyshev. ADAU1452. S/N 110 dB (digital). Alpine PC software + Alpine Remote Control app.

source.software: Alpine PC software / Alpine Remote Control app

products.notes: Distributor copy. Powered 8-inch subwoofer enclosure with built-in 4.1 DSP amp: 25 W x4 @4 ohm (4 ohm min, not bridgeable) + internal sub 165 W (peak 50 W x4 + 240 W). Inputs: 4 high-level (100 ohm) + 4 RCA (20 kohm) + Bluetooth (USB dongle). 10-band PEQ (Q 0.404-28.85), delay 0-5.4 ms (0-187 cm), crossover 6/12 dB/oct ch1-4, 6-24 dB/oct ch5; phase 0/180. S/N >=80 dB. Free Alpine PC software (USB) + smartphone app. Discontinued.
